name: zrndr_set_inverse_z_tolerance
description: zRndr::SetInverseZTolerance updates the renderer inverse-Z tolerance and mirrors it to the pending hardware renderer value only for non-software renderer paths.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zModel display/zRndr bridge setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel display and zRndr draw-path pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x476300 validates a stdcall leaf function that stores the stack float argument into g_zRndr_InverseZTolerance, checks g_zVideo_ActiveRendererPath, skips the mirror for software renderer path zero, and otherwise stores the same float bits into g_zVideo_InverseZTolerancePending before returning with callee cleanup.
The native smoke verifies the unconditional renderer tolerance update, software-path skip of the pending hardware mirror, non-software mirror update, and signed float preservation.
